CORRUPTR by TÂCHES — v1.0.0
Installation Guide
===========================

WHAT'S IN THE BOX
- CORRUPTR.pkg — the installer (VST3 + AU, ~3.7 MB)

HOW TO INSTALL
1. Double-click CORRUPTR.pkg
2. Follow the installer (Continue → Install)
3. The plugin installs into YOUR user plugin folders:
   ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/CORRUPTR.vst3
   ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/CORRUPTR.component
4. Open your DAW and rescan plugins if needed

FIRST USE — IMPORTANT (unsigned plugin)
macOS may block the plugin on first load because it is not notarized:
1. Try to load CORRUPTR in your DAW
2. If blocked: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway"
3. Confirm — this is a one-time step per format (VST3 and AU)

If the .pkg itself is blocked on opening: right-click → Open → Open.

REQUIREMENTS
- macOS 14.6+ (Apple Silicon), any VST3/AU host
  (Ableton Live, Logic Pro, FL Studio, Reaper, Bitwig...)

QUICK START
Use the preset strip at the top — try Warm Tape, Talk Box,
8-Bit Arcade, Metal Tank, and (with the transport playing)
Gate Chopper. Cmd+L latches the XY pad for live performance;
keys 1–7 fire the performance triggers on the Performance page.

Enjoy the noise.
